description: Experimental Rust rewrite of Rez package manager core components
notes: rez-next is experimental and not intended for production use.
Only the x86_64 Windows build is published here: the arm64 archive nests its
binaries under a different per-architecture path, so a single manifest cannot
address both without per-architecture extract_dir support.
The archive also ships rez.exe. It is deliberately NOT shimmed as `rez` to
avoid shadowing a real rez installation; run it from the app directory if needed.
